newsitem.title: FRANCE: Legris in talks to buy MAN unit.
newsitem.headline: Legris in talks to buy MAN unit.

text.p: Construction equipment manufacturer Legris Industries said on Tuesday it was in "advanced discussions" that would lead to its Potain subsidiary buying MAN Wolfkkran Gmbh, a wholly owned unit of MAN GHH AG.
MAN Wolffkran Gmbh is the second largest maker of tower cranes in Germany and had 1996 sales of 65 million marks, excluding crane hire, Legris said in a statement.
"Groupe Legris Industries and MAN GHH AG announce that they are in advanced discussions for Potain, a subsidiary of Groupe Legris Industries, to buy MAN Wolffkran Gmbh," it said.
It gave no financial details concerning the talks.
MAN Wolffkran Gmbh has a staff of 220.
Legris said Potain would maintain and develop the Wolff brand and keep producing cranes at the company's factory in Heilbronn, south of Frankfurt.
